skill_description: Reusable dependency skill for programmatic access to biological databases across eight retrieval domains: ncbi (Entrez + Datasets v2 CLI), reads (SRA/ENA/STRIDES), geo (SuperSeries detection), id-mapping (UniProt/Ensembl/BioMart), orthologs-precomputed (OrthoDB/Compara), marker-references (eDNA metabarcoding reference libraries: UNITE via PlutoF/DOI, BOLD API, Mitohelper/SILVA/PR2/MIDORI2, gdown-for-Drive), occurrence-marine (OBIS occurrence/checklist/dataset retrieval with WKT/year filters), and taxonomy (NCBI Datasets taxonomy + Catalogue of Life XR via ChecklistBank + WoRMS AphiaIDs). Every fetch script emits manifest.tsv with contract_version so consumer skills get a stable testable contract; credentials (NCBI, GBIF, BOLD) surface in preflight; licenses (CC-BY-NC) surface explicitly. Compute-heavy topics (BLAST, remote homology, interaction networks) are out of scope. Read-side counterpart of ena-submit; pairs with lit-fetch (papers vs biological records). Built via bioinfo-skill-creator.

tool_inventory.name: requests
tool_inventory.role: UniProt REST, Ensembl REST, ENA API, cloud mirrors

tool_inventory.name: gdown
tool_inventory.role: Google Drive downloads (DECIPHER pre-trained SILVA/PR2 trainingFiles hosted on Drive; curl returns quota-exceeded HTML)

tool_inventory.name: pyobis
tool_inventory.role: OBIS occurrence/taxa/checklist/dataset API client (marine biodiversity; pairs with GBIF occurrence for cross-checks)

warnings: Reference corpus topics are prose+examples, not AiX-BIO-vetted skill content: conversion to sub-skill format (signature libraries, battle tests, docs-corpus) is real work, staged per sub-skill.
Battle-test plan must be fixtures-first with opt-in scheduled live canaries: live Entrez/UniProt tests are nondeterministic (rate limits, weekly index lag, endpoint migrations).

Naming boundary: skills/ortholog-inference already exists but covers DE NOVO OrthoFinder3 inference. This skill's orthologs-precomputed sub-skill only RETRIEVES pre-computed orthologs (OrthoDB/Compara/OMA/eggNOG/PANTHER) - neither replaces the other; state the boundary in both READMEs.

No skill-to-skill dependency enforcement exists in the agent-skill ecosystem: consumers couple implicitly. Mitigation chosen: manifest.tsv contract_version asserted by consumer preflight (see brainstortm decision the brainstorm ledger).
Runtime behavior depends on network access and an NCBI api_key (3->10 req/s); preflight of the new skill must check both and degrade gracefully to anonymous 3 req/s.
brainstorm_evidence: brainstorm artifacts (r0/r1 position + relay files; regenerable, ephemeral) - see preflight.md Dissent section
